identity: Exact VU Aardwetenschappen code 56986, Dutch full-time. Adopted 2026–2027 OER controls the selected entrant curriculum. Current marketing explicitly describes the 2027–2028 redesign; its broad first-two-year sequence is not mixed with the adopted 2026 route.

route.basis: The 2026–27 OER confirms two formal tracks; neither is uniquely representative of the broad Earth Sciences target. The first-listed Aardoppervlak track is chosen under the neutral order tie-break and its complete 60-EC second-year path is used. The choice was made without considering UCR fit.

components: Duurzaam gebruik van de NL ondergrond
Genuinely open academic 30-EC profiling space; no Earth-science elective is invented.
externalVerification.allocation: 60 required year 1 +39 common year 2 +21 required first-listed Aardoppervlak route +6 hydrology +6 philosophy/history +18 thesis +30 open profiling =180 unique EC. Other route, honours and zero-credit obligations not stacked.
externalVerification.progression: 15 programmed year-1 EC before 1 March for Jumilla; report after fieldwork. Before 1 February, 54 required EC and passed Jumilla report for excursion/Jura; Jura report follows fieldwork and must be passed before thesis. Ordinary complete year sequence satisfies these thresholds. February thesis registration/approved forms and the report page’s separate 1 March passing statement are retained together without relaxing OER prerequisite.
externalVerification.thesis: Current 2026–2027 AB_1096 record: planning1+English scientific writing2+individual research15=18. Field/lab/modelling work possible. AB_1075 report current course page explicitly requires timely chapters/peer feedback, draft/final each50%.
externalVerification.openSpace: 30 EC genuine open academic space; individual choices at least12EC level300 and at most6EC level100; prior approval except eligible minors. Foreign study same levels, max6EC master not reusable later.
externalVerification.noncredit: Dutch test/remediation, year2 study/career attendance, assignments, LinkedIn and network report; BSA42EC subject to exceptions. No extra EC.
